current: Inherited FastChem Lodders 2004 five-coefficient fit, not a NASA/ATcT hybrid. Source attribution corroborated; complete historical fit training/provenance remains unavailable.

primary_sources.access: Full author PDF, sections 2.3 and tables 1,6,7 inspected.
primary_sources.finding: Lodders selects spectroscopic D0=463 +/-24 kJ/mol and Hf298=283.40 +/-24; original JANAF NS formation values are erroneous. Thermal functions use Gurvich.

primary_sources.access: Full author-repository PDF inspected; do not conflate its recommendation with Lodders.
primary_sources.finding: Peebles and Marshall report Hf0=277.3 +/-2 and Hf298=278.0 +/-2 kJ/mol from three CCSD(T) working reactions; the paper gives D0=468.2 kJ/mol.

primary_sources.access: Full author PDF section3.2 and official states/PF/definition inspected.
primary_sources.finding: SNaSH includes X2Pi rovibronic levels, 14N32S gtot has nuclear spin factor3. Higher a4Pi electronic state is omitted; paper estimates its effect below1% at5000K. That is an author estimate, not a quantified uncertainty established here.

secondary_confirmation.access: NS note76 inspected through primary evaluator PDF text
secondary_confirmation.finding: JPL2019 names Lodders thermal update and Peebles–Marshall energy recommendation separately.

decision: Retain production for this source review; prioritize a Peebles/JPL energy candidate with explicitly balanced reference atoms and a substitution solve. Do not replace corrected Lodders by old NASA or uncorrected JANAF simply to reduce their ratio. SNaSH supports the current thermal family and does not require thermal replacement.
limitations: Lodders molecular+NASA atomic reconstruction intentionally differs in atomic convention and inherited fit by approximately1–2%; it is an attribution diagnostic, not exact recovery of the historical fitting process.
Peebles H298 shift is only a scale diagnostic; no modern ATcT NS value or same-version NS/atom network has been pinned.
Natural elemental translation and one principal isotope Q are an approximation; explicit isotope mixture is uncomputed.
No new equilibrium solve; trace footprint on this grid is not a statement about all planetary atmospheres.
